tie_rule: average rank for equal scores; fused ties break by scheme C rank, then candidate index

rules.B: equal weight of epoch6 rank and scheme C rank
rules.C: equal weight of scheme C rank and conditioned seed 0 rank
rules.D: equal weight of scheme C rank and conditioned seed 1 rank
rules.E: equal weight of scheme C rank and the mean rank of pair seeds 0-4
